plans.note: Primary text in Section 21 (Limitation of Liability): check mutuality, cap quantum/multiplier, exclusion of consequential damages, and whether carve-outs run through the 'Excluded Claims' definition in Section 1 and the indemnities in Section 20.

Section 20 is the indemnity clause; confirm Vendor IP infringement, data breach and misconduct indemnities in our favour, that any Customer indemnity is narrow, and that indemnity sits outside the Section 21 cap via Excluded Claims.

No dedicated restrictive-covenant section in the outline; scan Customer Responsibilities, Access Rights/Licence use restrictions, Compliance and General for any buried covenant not to build or buy competing products before concluding absent.
Check Agreement Structure and Scope and Order Forms for sole-source/exclusive-supplier language, and Fees for exclusivity-linked pricing; likely no standalone exclusivity clause.
Look in Fees/Invoicing and Order Forms for any most-favoured-customer or best-terms language; only flag if it obliges us to give Vendor our best terms — MFN in our favour is welcome.
Non-solicit is typically parked in General (Section 30) or Customer Responsibilities; check duration, whether it is mutual, and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

Section 9 (Termination) is primary: confirm Customer convenience right, notice length, absence of early-termination fees (cross-check Section 7 and Section 10), and that Vendor has no reciprocal mid-term convenience exit.
Section 8 (Term and Renewal): check auto-renewal term length, non-renewal notice window, and any renewal price uplift cap in Section 7.
Section 28 governs law, venue and dispute resolution; confirm an accepted jurisdiction and courts rather than foreign-seated arbitration, noting escalation steps.
Section 24 (Assignment and Change of Control): confirm our right to assign to Affiliates and successors without consent and that Vendor cannot terminate or reprice on our change of control.
Section 14 for Deliverables ownership and any feedback/residuals grant to Vendor; Section 15 for Customer Data ownership and permitted use (watch aggregated/derived data rights).
Section 13 (Access Rights and Licence): check scope covers Affiliates and contractors/users, and that the grant is not revocable at will or suspendable without cure.

Section 22 sets audits of our usage — check frequency, advance notice, business-hours/off-site limits, cost allocation and any shortfall true-up; Section 23 may contain the reciprocal records/assurance rights in our favour (do not flag those).

Check Fees for late-payment interest or stated penalties and Section 3 for any performance-related sums payable by us; service credits running to us under the SLA are beneficial and should not be flagged.

Section 19 (Warranties): check warranty period length, that the remedy is real (re-perform/refund) not sole-and-exclusive-to-repair-only, and any disclaimer language; cross-check acceptance in Section 6.
Section 18 (Insurance): verify coverage lines (CGL, professional/E&O, cyber), limits, and certificate/notice obligations given Vendor hosts our data.
Look for committed spend, minimum volumes or non-reducible quantities in Fees and Order Forms; if present, confirm an exit or reduction mechanism aligned with the termination rights in Section 9.

Section 11 (Transition Assistance and Data Return): check duration of assistance, pricing basis, export format and deletion timing; cross-check Section 10 effects of termination and Section 15 data provisions.
